Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions of access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
 
 
About The Opportunity
OKX is looking for a Senior AI Creative Innovator(Paid Ads) to develop AIGC video and AI-animated assets for paid ads to drive OKX’s global market growth and product launches.
 
 
What You’ll Be Doing
  • Concept and execute high-impact creatives for ads growth and marketing, from initial brief through final asset delivery
  • Use AI to accelerate every phase of the design process: ideation, moodboarding, asset variation, copy iteration, and production polish.
  • Sort out AIGC prompts and internal visual resource library to improve design efficiency.
  • Possess fluency with generative AI tools across the design stack (Figma AI, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini VEO, Seedance etc)
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and advocate for design decisions with clarity and conviction
 
What We Look For In You
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5 years of experience in design with a focus on marketing, advertising, or performance creative—ideally in tech, fintech, or a high-growth startup environment
  • Active hands-on proficiency with AI image & animation creative tools, translating AI capabilities into performing creatives and business outcomes
  • Comfort working at speed in a remote environment while maintaining a high bar for work quality
  • Experience partnering with business development and local market teams to produce and iterate on ad creative
  • Proficiency in Mandarin and English is required to collaborate across our multilingual, cross-regional teams
 
Perks & Benefits
  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!
